full_text: Intro Top 10 Mortgage Broker Software and Tools for Lending Business Home » Top 10 Mortgage Broker Software and Tools for Lending Business Many times mortgage brokers find themselves in a tough situation due to a lack of synergy with their technology stack, such as an incomplete or out of date CRM and pipeline systems. CRM systems out of sync with the pipeline means that many leads are lost, and when the software processes documents slowly, it leads to wasted time and unhappy borrowers. In addition to hindering efficiency, disconnected software can also result in financial loss. A mortgage technology stack that works for many mortgage brokers will help to keep a smooth pipeline, ensure regulatory compliance, and provide borrowers with appropriate communication during the entire loan process. To effectively evaluate a mortgage technology solution, it is critical to understand the three primary software functions that need to be addressed: CRM for managing leads, LOS for processing loans, and POS for borrower communication. We researched ten different best mortgage broker software solutions based on their specific advantages, features, disadvantages, and ability to serve mortgage brokers. What is a Mortgage Broker Software? Mortgage software/mortgage lending software provides brokers and lenders with a centralized database for tracking their complete mortgage management through one system. Most mortgage software packages have both CRM and Loan Originator functionality. This allows brokers to manage customer relationships, process, file loan applications, and maintain compliance with regulations. A reliable custom mortgage software solution ultimately results in an organized and streamlined mortgage workflow. Key Features To Look For In Mortgage Software To find the best mortgage software for your company, look at these critical features: Loan Origination All steps of the origination process, from application submission through underwriters to closing, are tracked by one application. Document Management It refers to managing documents digitally and storing them in a safe virtual place to access conveniently. Credit Analysis A mortgage software should have a strong feature to evaluate the credit reports, any other relevant data and income verification documents. Automated Underwriting It involves using algorithms to analyze risk and to decide whether a loan should be approved or refused according to specific underwriting criteria. Compliance Management Automating compliance checks will enable you to remain compliant with lending laws and regulations throughout the loan life cycle. Customer Relationship Management A CRM allows you to manage contacts with customers, keep track of leads, communicate with your borrowers and monitor your referral sources in one integrated solution. Reporting and Analytics Customizable reports and analysis dashboards assist in getting the information you require regarding your lending operations. The 10 Best Mortgage Broker Software Tools The loan origination system (LOS) simplifies the process of lending for mortgage lenders and their customers through a systematic way to keep both parties organized throughout the process of obtaining a loan. It provides assistance during the entire loan origination process from the time a borrower applies for a form of documentation through to underwriting and ultimately to the approval of the mortgage application. Each mortgage software tool is assessed through the lens of its primary strengths; the best use case; specific, individual features; and its clarity of pricing. Let’s explore each one by one: 1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) remains one of the leading enterprise-grade, complex financial institutions and large mortgage brokerages CRMs. It provides a 360-degree view of borrowers by consolidating various pieces of data into a unified borrower experience. Overall, it is a great platform to manage and build great relationships with the clients. Core Strengths Uses Einstein AI to improve lead scoring, obtain actionable insight on the best next action for a customer and to automate routine tasks more smartly. Salesforce Shield provides access to encrypted transmission and user activity monitoring. Through Action Plans, all workflows are documented, audit-ready and produce a compliant and repeatable loan processing experience. Salesforce offers the best integration capabilities with third party originations systems (LOS) and with the wider AppExchange marketplace. Key Features Tracking every loan opportunity from starting through funding using visual dashboards. Automation of complex, multi-step processes helps reduce human error and improve compliance and operational efficiency. Step-by-step guided applications help streamline the borrower experience with digital applications. Integration of data from multiple lines of business allows for personalized interaction with users. Drawbacks It is not a standalone LOS. It offers a great deal of flexibility but requires a tremendous amount of configuration to implement specific mortgage workflows. Typically, consultants are engaged to assist in this effort. Requires Salesforce Enterprise or Unlimited Edition, plus a per-user charge for each industry-specific feature. The implementation/maintenance cost can be very high. Best For Large scale brokerages (Lenders) and Banks that are lending at a high volume and require robust security, scalability, and the ability to create custom solutions. 2. Encompass by ICE Mortgage Technology ICE Mortgage Technology’s Encompass is recognized across the mortgage industry as being the gold standard for full-fledged loan origination systems (LOS). This loan origination software has been designed specifically to support mid-large scale lenders and banks through providing a full end-to-end solution for digital mortgages. Best For: High-volume mid- to large-size brokerage companies, mortgage bankers, and financial institutions in need of enterprise-level technology. Must have for brokers and lenders. Core Strength: The Encompass software product supports all aspects of the loan lifecycle, including retail, wholesale, correspondent, and direct-to-consumer. It is best known for its ability to stay ahead of large regulatory changes in the mortgage industry (TRID, HMDA, MERS) and to implement them well before they go into effect. Encompass is connected to thousands of third-party applications through its partner network, including automated underwriting, title, and escrow services. Key Features: Encompass leverages ICE Mortgage Analyzers with AI to automatically recognize documents, extract data, and compare the results with the loan origination system. It meets MISMO 2.1 standards for communicating with an automated underwriting system. Encompass has deep partnerships with the most significant secondary market investors (FNMA/FHLMC) for seamless integration. Encompass provides a completely digital closing experience. Pricing The custom pricing is developed on the basis of user count and closed loan volume. Ranges from approximately $135 per month per user plus an estimated cost of between $160 and $500 for each closed loan, based on configuration. One Honest Drawback: With such a large variety of functions and customizable options available, this can be a very difficult solution for small independent brokers or new loan officers to get started because it is so expensive. Most of the time, in-house specialists will be needed to maintain the system. 2026 Update Note: For the years 2025 and 2026, ICE implemented new API-based modern platforms that provided more efficient operations than the legacy SDKs used in previous years. The newly implemented API-based platforms have improved functionality and speed. 3. BankPoint BankPoint functions as a loan management and workflow automation platform which helps financial institutions automate processes that include document management and customer relationship management. It is ideal for banks and credit unions looking to streamline daily operations and maintain regulatory compliance. However, it is not a full-fledged core banking system or a complete loan origination system (LOS), as it primarily focuses on managing loan workflows rather than handling the entire loan lifecycle. Core Strength: BankPoint enhances operational efficiency and streamlines workflows, which will improve performance and eliminate stress related to day-to-day activities. Key Features: Includes features to enhance operational efficiencies and customer service through automated workflows, reporting tools, and secure data management. Pricing: There are no specific pricing details as the program lacks readily available information. However, users require contacting the vendor directly for a price quote. One Honest Drawback: It is not a full LOS so organizations using BankPoint will need additional tools for end-to-end mortgage processing especially for large-scale environments. 4. Calyx Point Calyx Point is a comprehensive mortgage origination/processing software solution allowing for a single user-friendly platform for processing loans, underwriting them, and closing them. The all-in-one mortgage lending software is designed to help you complete each essential task associated with the mortgage process while relieving you from the complexity and cost of using a separate enterprise-based mortgage system. Best for: Mortgage brokers who are looking for a reliable loan origination system (LOS) that has been used successfully to support the same operational activities every day. It is best known for direct communication capabilities. Core strength: Calyx Point has a long history in this industry, and it has earned an excellent reputation as a reliable platform. It has been around for a long time, with an established and loyal customer base who appreciate the proven ability to perform over time. Key features: Calyx Point supports all standard loan application forms, as well as integrating with Automated Underwriting Systems (DU, LP). It also includes many of the tools needed to complete loan processing efficiently, such as fee worksheets and document management tools, which allow a seamless loan processing workflow. Supports basic loan marketing and communication workflows Pricing: Calyx Point is $299 up front to license. After that it is charged at a monthly license fee for each “seat” you license. This is predictable for teams trying to keep track of who is accessing the software through a user-based access control model. One honest drawback: One drawback of using Calyx is that its interface feels outdated when compared to other newer platforms, specifically modern-cloud platforms. 5. Floify (check) Floify offers a unique digital mortgage Point-of-Sale (POS) system. It provides lenders, brokers and borrowers with a secure and easy-to-navigate interface for submitting documents, communicating regarding their loans, and tracking their loans from application until they have been completed. Best For For companies who want their borrowers to have better overall online experiences and who want to create greater efficiencies in their operations. Floify provides a smooth, intuitive, and modern way of allowing borrowers to submit required documents and to track their application status. Core Strengths Reduced the amount of time spent collecting documents. A safe and simple way for you to upload/download your documents and check the loan’s status. Ensures that everyone involved (borrower, loan officer, and third-parties) is up to date to avoid delays and reduce last-minute rush. Workflows can easily be reverted to meet your company’s needs. Has high security standards Has custom plans Key Features Secure place to submit confidential documents. Electronic signatures accelerate document signing. Always transparency in the loan pipeline. Developed as a powerful Point Of Sale. Certain editions include MCM and Dual AUS (FNMA & FHLMC). Pricing Most common pricing includes per loan and monthly subscriptions with month-to-month fees. $74 per month for single users. One Honest Drawback While an outstanding front-end point-of-sale (POS), the software does not offer adequate full loan origination capabilities as it is not a LOS platform. Therefore, the software requires interfacing with another back-end processing solution to provide full loan origination capabilities. 6. MeridianLink Mortgage MeridianLink Mortgage (formerly Lending QB) is an integrated, cloud-based, browser-accessible loan origination software designed for community banks, credit unions, and mortgage banking entities. It is recognized as a highly effective tool for improving operational efficiency and creating a seamless, 100% digital experience for both borrowers and lenders. Best for: Credit unions and community banks are looking to simplify their lending process but may not have the same level of IT infrastructure as larger national banks. Lenders are looking for a fully digitized transformation within their organization and to transition from manual and paper-based processes to operate in a completely digitized, cloud-based lending environment. Financial Institutions looking for speedy, configurable automation for their lending operations; primarily integrated rules engines and configurable workflows for expediting underwriting and improving compliance. Core Strengths: It is a cloud based solution with all components that allows the lender to eliminate the cost of maintaining an in-house infrastructure. In addition, the software is automatically updated and maintained without any manual effort on the part of the lender. The software-as-a-service (SaaS) model means no hardware, so you can save on in-house hardware costs and receive automatic, uninterrupted upgrades to your software. Its PriceMyLoan Platform has an open application programming interface (API) that gives users access to a wide range of vendors and allows for individual customization of “best in Class” workflows. Key Features: A completely digital, mobile-first borrower experience that allows Borrowers to submit documents and track their Loan Status in real-time. Programmatic logic allows for rapid movement through the pipeline. Several customers are obtaining decisions within two hours. Supports E-Docs, E-Signatures and provides tools for real-time collaboration to facilitate a complete paperless closing. Provides a specialized third party origination portal that allows users to efficiently manage their broker and correspondent lender relationships. Built-in auditing and compliance features provide real-time auditing of regulatory compliance throughout the loan process. Pricing: MeridianLink Mortgage normally uses an enterprise pricing structure. The pricing is not available online so it is advised to book a demo. One Honest Drawback: A large number of configuration options and capabilities mean there is a steep initial learning curve for employees to use this system. Although MeridianLink is a very powerful system, it may be difficult to implement due to how extensively it can be configured and requires a prolonged time to implement. 7. Blue Sage Blue Sage provides a complete suite of digital lending platforms for the mortgage industry. They focus on the use of artificial intelligence technology to create faster and more efficient processing of loans while maintaining compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. Its vision is to create a holistic, consistent, scalable and seamless digital mortgage experience by utilizing all aspects of AI in their entire lending process to help lower costs and increase efficiency. Best for: Institutions searching for a modern, cloud-native Loan Origination System (LOS) that they can have up and running in 6 to 10 months. These institutions operate through retail, wholesale and correspondent channels and are looking for a single unified system of record. Core Strengths: The mortgage business software is built from scratch to be 100% browser-based. Therefore, it offers a fast, scalable, and accessible application to any user with a web-enabled device. It is a single platform merging LOS, POS and digital servicing. It removes the requirement for third-party software. With in-depth AI integration, it offers smart task automation, quick document identification and 24/7 sales agent for looking after leads. Lenders can customize Blue Sage according to their platforms as it offers high-configuration flexibility. Key Features: Blue Sage offers a mobile-optimized borrower portal that works on quick document uploading, real-time tracking and faster eSigning. Workflow/tasks will be executed automatically based on trigger events, Has an AI-based conversational agent used by loan officers to create loan scenarios, look up required loan data, and communicate with borrowers. Compliance with federal, state, and local regulations is built-in, with real-time verification and regulatory analysis completed at every phase in the loan process. Pricing: Blue Sage does not offer prices available to the public at this time. So, booking a demo is the right way to discover its features. Each quote is provided solely for that quote’s circumstances. The solution is generally delivered using Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) pricing model. One Honest Drawback: Many end-users report that the platform operates at high levels of performance. However, many end-users have also stated that implementation costs are significantly higher along with the ongoing costs of consulting and customizations. 8. LendingPad LendingPad is a technologically advanced, cloud-created loan origination (LOS) software created for mortgage agency lenders and small to medium teams in search of budget-friendly software that is efficient and In compliance with laws. Its strengths consist of built-in collaborative features, real-time updates via MISMO data, and built-in AUS integration. While its fees tend to be lower than traditional platforms’, some users reported mid-level third party integration. Best For: It is an affordable cloud-based loan origination software solution for independent brokers and/or small-to-medium teams that want an accessible, highly responsive, full-featured platform. As cloud-based software, remote employees working from any secure web browser have secure access to the application and corresponding database. Key Strengths: Affordably priced with a great focus on efficiency rather than needing more amounts of time and effort to maintain. Include automated compliance review tools, CRM and document management capabilities, and automated underwriting systems. Allows many users to edit the same document at the same time which increases the amount of work that can be completed accurately and quickly. Simple/quick and easy setup does not require extensive IT support. Key Features: Custom versions of software are available for brokers, lenders, banks and credit unions. Bi-directional API interfaces for real-time data sharing; built-in lender marketplace AWS-based hosting and annual SSAE16 SOC2 audit for maximum security It has automated workflow tools Pricing: Approximately $40–$55 per user/month. Per-user subscription (monthly or annually). Trial/Demo is available for loan officers (to obtain full details) One Honest Drawback: Users may experience fewer third party integrations with smaller, less traditional, niche type products versus legacy, large product offerings. 9. TurnKey Lender TurnKey Lender is an established leader in AI-enabled application processing automation in an end-to-end automated process. It uses advanced deep learning neural networks, and machine language algorithms to predictively score each applicant’s creditworthiness in less than 30 seconds. The key functions of this software solution include origination, underwriting, servicing, collection of debts, and compliance. Best for: Alternative lenders Fintech start-ups Embedded finance providers Traditional financial institutions looking to transform digitally and rapidly at scale Businesses wanting to get new lending products to market quickly ie BNPL/Buy Now Pay Later, Personal Loans etc. Core Strength: Through the use of proprietary artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, TurnKey can automate the whole loan lifecycle in one place very quickly. It results in risk and cost reductions and fosters smart decision making. Key Features: Use of deep neural networks to analyze the borrower’s risk based on both traditional and alternative data. Removes paper applications by digitizing the whole application process allowing for custom workflows, web-flow, and automated KYC/AML checks. Allows users to configure credit product parameters without having to write any code. Manages repayment schedules, sends reminders, collects automatically, and, increases cash flow. White label borrower portal provides an interface that lets borrowers apply for loans and manage their repayments easily. Pricing: Turnkey Lender has pricing (and subscription pricing typically starts at approximately $500 per month). The ultimate price is customized depending on the actual type of lending entity, size of the organization, and functionality of features needed. You can get a custom quote for your lender operation. One Honest Drawback: The lending solution platform TurnKey Lender provides complete lending services but its main service area covers consumer and alternative lending markets which include personal loans and BNPL services. The mortgage brokers will discover that certain platform functions do not match their standard home loan processes because the software lacks complete mortgage LOS capabilities. 10. Finflux Finflux is an end-to-end “cloud-based” lending solution for digital lenders, microfinance companies, and the fintech industry. FinFlux combines loan origination, loan administration, and collection processes into one software solution. By having an extensible design and API integrations, Finflux automates workflow processes and increases operational efficiency by overseeing the complete loan process. Best for: Online lending companies, microfinance organizations, fintech startups that need a detailed, cloud-based full-loan lifecycle management solution. Core strength: Finflux provides complete end-to-end cloud-based solutions for each step in the lending process. It provides maximum flexibility and integration capabilities for users who typically do not have in-house developers. It works well with other mortgage systems. Each service works together seamlessly to provide lower costs and higher quality results than if the services were purchased separately. Key features: Automates all the activities associated with the origination of loans. This includes the onboarding of borrowers through KYC verification, credit assessments and subsequent approvals. Tracks all aspects of loans during their life cycle including disbursement, payment, interest calculation, servicing and so on. Allows users to create collections strategies by using different types of automated reminders (letters, emails, SMS) to remind customers of past due payments, as well as manage recovery processes. Give users the flexibility to connect to external systems such as Credit Bureaus, Payment Gateways, and Analytics Platforms. Pricing: Generally comes with a monthly/annual fee as per customer needs. Pricing will vary based on business growth potential, as well as the size of the lender, loan volume for each client and features required by each lender. One honest drawback: During the initial configuration, there could be an extensive amount of complexity with setting up a system based upon a client’s specific requirements. User reviews indicate that there is a longer timeframe with also needing to receive technical assistance to achieve optimal functionality. How to Choose the Right Mortgage Software Solution? When evaluating mortgage software options, consider these items to make the right selection for your organization: Parameters Explanation Company Size Identify if you are a small broker, mid-sized lender or very large company. Industry Focus Determine what your needs as an industry are and look for software that meets those needs. Specific Needs Specify and review your business goals and budget. Integration Ensure that the software you are selecting works with your existing systems, like credit bureaus, accounting solutions and digital document solutions. Scalability Think about how scalable the software is to allow you to provide the same pipeline for multiple lenders or branches. Compliance and Regulatory Support Make sure you choose a solution that provides sufficient regulatory support to avoid high levels of mistakes that may put your organization at risk for non-compliance. User Experience Look at the user experience of the software, including ease of use, customer support and training resources. When looking for the perfect mortgage software solutions, don’t just look for a one size fits all mortgage program. Instead, look for profit-making tools that will complement your workflow, employee count, and long-term profitability. A small brokerage might find a combination of systems won’t work at all for them. Conversely, there are systems small brokerages could use that would be perfect for a company that is growing. Utilizing free demos or trial programs before your final purchase will give you a great chance to see how each software program will function in a real world environment. This will help you to reveal any gaps in functionality, usability issues and the level of integration that each program provides. In Conclusion: When assessing your technology stack today, you should compare what you are using right now against a core grouping of technologies including CRM, LOS, and POS. It is very important to ensure all of the systems then work together seamlessly. While using a perfectly integrated technology stack, look for enhanced productivity, compliance and user experience for your customers. The combined features of your mortgage technology stack and high-quality, customer relationship management technology will give you the tools you need to take your operations to the next level. Most mortgage software packages have both CRM and Loan Originator functionality. This allows brokers to manage customer relationships, process, file loan applications, and maintain compliance with regulations. A reliable custom mortgage software solution ultimately results in an organized and streamlined mortgage workflow. Credit Analysis A mortgage software should have a strong feature to evaluate the credit reports, any other relevant data and income verification documents. Automated Underwriting It involves using algorithms to analyze risk and to decide whether a loan should be approved or refused according to specific underwriting criteria. Compliance Management Automating compliance checks will enable you to remain compliant with lending laws and regulations throughout the loan life cycle. Customer Relationship Management A CRM allows you to manage contacts with customers, keep track of leads, communicate with your borrowers and monitor your referral sources in one integrated solution. sections.title: What is a Mortgage Broker Software?
sections.content: Mortgage software/mortgage lending software provides brokers and lenders with a centralized database for tracking their complete mortgage management through one system. Most mortgage software packages have both CRM and Loan Originator functionality. This allows brokers to manage customer relationships, process, file loan applications, and maintain compliance with regulations. A reliable custom mortgage software solution ultimately results in an organized and streamlined mortgage workflow.

sections.title: Key Features To Look For In Mortgage Software
sections.content: To find the best mortgage software for your company, look at these critical features: Loan Origination All steps of the origination process, from application submission through underwriters to closing, are tracked by one application. Document Management It refers to managing documents digitally and storing them in a safe virtual place to access conveniently. Credit Analysis A mortgage software should have a strong feature to evaluate the credit reports, any other relevant data and income verification documents. Automated Underwriting It involves using algorithms to analyze risk and to decide whether a loan should be approved or refused according to specific underwriting criteria. Compliance Management Automating compliance checks will enable you to remain compliant with lending laws and regulations throughout the loan life cycle. Customer Relationship Management A CRM allows you to manage contacts with customers, keep track of leads, communicate with your borrowers and monitor your referral sources in one integrated solution. Reporting and Analytics Customizable reports and analysis dashboards assist in getting the information you require regarding your lending operations.

sections.title: The 10 Best Mortgage Broker Software Tools
sections.content: The loan origination system (LOS) simplifies the process of lending for mortgage lenders and their customers through a systematic way to keep both parties organized throughout the process of obtaining a loan. It provides assistance during the entire loan origination process from the time a borrower applies for a form of documentation through to underwriting and ultimately to the approval of the mortgage application. Each mortgage software tool is assessed through the lens of its primary strengths; the best use case; specific, individual features; and its clarity of pricing. Let’s explore each one by one:

sections.title: 1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud
sections.content: Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) remains one of the leading enterprise-grade, complex financial institutions and large mortgage brokerages CRMs. It provides a 360-degree view of borrowers by consolidating various pieces of data into a unified borrower experience. Overall, it is a great platform to manage and build great relationships with the clients. Core Strengths Uses Einstein AI to improve lead scoring, obtain actionable insight on the best next action for a customer and to automate routine tasks more smartly. Salesforce Shield provides access to encrypted transmission and user activity monitoring. Through Action Plans, all workflows are documented, audit-ready and produce a compliant and repeatable loan processing experience. Salesforce offers the best integration capabilities with third party originations systems (LOS) and with the wider AppExchange marketplace. Key Features Tracking every loan opportunity from starting through funding using visual dashboards. Automation of complex, multi-step processes helps reduce human error and improve compliance and operational efficiency. Step-by-step guided applications help streamline the borrower experience with digital applications. Integration of data from multiple lines of business allows for personalized interaction with users. Drawbacks It is not a standalone LOS. It offers a great deal of flexibility but requires a tremendous amount of configuration to implement specific mortgage workflows. Typically, consultants are engaged to assist in this effort. Requires Salesforce Enterprise or Unlimited Edition, plus a per-user charge for each industry-specific feature. The implementation/maintenance cost can be very high. Best For Large scale brokerages (Lenders) and Banks that are lending at a high volume and require robust security, scalability, and the ability to create custom solutions.

sections.title: 2. Encompass by ICE Mortgage Technology
sections.content: ICE Mortgage Technology’s Encompass is recognized across the mortgage industry as being the gold standard for full-fledged loan origination systems (LOS). This loan origination software has been designed specifically to support mid-large scale lenders and banks through providing a full end-to-end solution for digital mortgages. Best For: High-volume mid- to large-size brokerage companies, mortgage bankers, and financial institutions in need of enterprise-level technology. Must have for brokers and lenders. Core Strength: The Encompass software product supports all aspects of the loan lifecycle, including retail, wholesale, correspondent, and direct-to-consumer. It is best known for its ability to stay ahead of large regulatory changes in the mortgage industry (TRID, HMDA, MERS) and to implement them well before they go into effect. Encompass is connected to thousands of third-party applications through its partner network, including automated underwriting, title, and escrow services. Key Features: Encompass leverages ICE Mortgage Analyzers with AI to automatically recognize documents, extract data, and compare the results with the loan origination system. It meets MISMO 2.1 standards for communicating with an automated underwriting system. Encompass has deep partnerships with the most significant secondary market investors (FNMA/FHLMC) for seamless integration. Encompass provides a completely digital closing experience. Pricing The custom pricing is developed on the basis of user count and closed loan volume. Ranges from approximately $135 per month per user plus an estimated cost of between $160 and $500 for each closed loan, based on configuration. One Honest Drawback: With such a large variety of functions and customizable options available, this can be a very difficult solution for small independent brokers or new loan officers to get started because it is so expensive. Most of the time, in-house specialists will be needed to maintain the system. 2026 Update Note: For the years 2025 and 2026, ICE implemented new API-based modern platforms that provided more efficient operations than the legacy SDKs used in previous years. The newly implemented API-based platforms have improved functionality and speed.

sections.title: 3. BankPoint
sections.content: BankPoint functions as a loan management and workflow automation platform which helps financial institutions automate processes that include document management and customer relationship management. It is ideal for banks and credit unions looking to streamline daily operations and maintain regulatory compliance. However, it is not a full-fledged core banking system or a complete loan origination system (LOS), as it primarily focuses on managing loan workflows rather than handling the entire loan lifecycle. Core Strength: BankPoint enhances operational efficiency and streamlines workflows, which will improve performance and eliminate stress related to day-to-day activities. Key Features: Includes features to enhance operational efficiencies and customer service through automated workflows, reporting tools, and secure data management. Pricing: There are no specific pricing details as the program lacks readily available information. However, users require contacting the vendor directly for a price quote. One Honest Drawback: It is not a full LOS so organizations using BankPoint will need additional tools for end-to-end mortgage processing especially for large-scale environments.

sections.title: 4. Calyx Point
sections.content: Calyx Point is a comprehensive mortgage origination/processing software solution allowing for a single user-friendly platform for processing loans, underwriting them, and closing them. The all-in-one mortgage lending software is designed to help you complete each essential task associated with the mortgage process while relieving you from the complexity and cost of using a separate enterprise-based mortgage system. Best for: Mortgage brokers who are looking for a reliable loan origination system (LOS) that has been used successfully to support the same operational activities every day. It is best known for direct communication capabilities. Core strength: Calyx Point has a long history in this industry, and it has earned an excellent reputation as a reliable platform. It has been around for a long time, with an established and loyal customer base who appreciate the proven ability to perform over time. Key features: Calyx Point supports all standard loan application forms, as well as integrating with Automated Underwriting Systems (DU, LP). It also includes many of the tools needed to complete loan processing efficiently, such as fee worksheets and document management tools, which allow a seamless loan processing workflow. Supports basic loan marketing and communication workflows Pricing: Calyx Point is $299 up front to license. After that it is charged at a monthly license fee for each “seat” you license. This is predictable for teams trying to keep track of who is accessing the software through a user-based access control model. One honest drawback: One drawback of using Calyx is that its interface feels outdated when compared to other newer platforms, specifically modern-cloud platforms.

sections.title: 5. Floify (check)
sections.content: Floify offers a unique digital mortgage Point-of-Sale (POS) system. It provides lenders, brokers and borrowers with a secure and easy-to-navigate interface for submitting documents, communicating regarding their loans, and tracking their loans from application until they have been completed. Best For For companies who want their borrowers to have better overall online experiences and who want to create greater efficiencies in their operations. Floify provides a smooth, intuitive, and modern way of allowing borrowers to submit required documents and to track their application status. Core Strengths Reduced the amount of time spent collecting documents. A safe and simple way for you to upload/download your documents and check the loan’s status. Ensures that everyone involved (borrower, loan officer, and third-parties) is up to date to avoid delays and reduce last-minute rush. Workflows can easily be reverted to meet your company’s needs. Has high security standards Has custom plans Key Features Secure place to submit confidential documents. Electronic signatures accelerate document signing. Always transparency in the loan pipeline. Developed as a powerful Point Of Sale. Certain editions include MCM and Dual AUS (FNMA & FHLMC). Pricing Most common pricing includes per loan and monthly subscriptions with month-to-month fees. $74 per month for single users. One Honest Drawback While an outstanding front-end point-of-sale (POS), the software does not offer adequate full loan origination capabilities as it is not a LOS platform. Therefore, the software requires interfacing with another back-end processing solution to provide full loan origination capabilities.

sections.title: 6. MeridianLink Mortgage
sections.content: MeridianLink Mortgage (formerly Lending QB) is an integrated, cloud-based, browser-accessible loan origination software designed for community banks, credit unions, and mortgage banking entities. It is recognized as a highly effective tool for improving operational efficiency and creating a seamless, 100% digital experience for both borrowers and lenders. Best for: Credit unions and community banks are looking to simplify their lending process but may not have the same level of IT infrastructure as larger national banks. Lenders are looking for a fully digitized transformation within their organization and to transition from manual and paper-based processes to operate in a completely digitized, cloud-based lending environment. Financial Institutions looking for speedy, configurable automation for their lending operations; primarily integrated rules engines and configurable workflows for expediting underwriting and improving compliance. Core Strengths: It is a cloud based solution with all components that allows the lender to eliminate the cost of maintaining an in-house infrastructure. In addition, the software is automatically updated and maintained without any manual effort on the part of the lender. The software-as-a-service (SaaS) model means no hardware, so you can save on in-house hardware costs and receive automatic, uninterrupted upgrades to your software. Its PriceMyLoan Platform has an open application programming interface (API) that gives users access to a wide range of vendors and allows for individual customization of “best in Class” workflows. Key Features: A completely digital, mobile-first borrower experience that allows Borrowers to submit documents and track their Loan Status in real-time. Programmatic logic allows for rapid movement through the pipeline. Several customers are obtaining decisions within two hours. Supports E-Docs, E-Signatures and provides tools for real-time collaboration to facilitate a complete paperless closing. Provides a specialized third party origination portal that allows users to efficiently manage their broker and correspondent lender relationships. Built-in auditing and compliance features provide real-time auditing of regulatory compliance throughout the loan process. Pricing: MeridianLink Mortgage normally uses an enterprise pricing structure. The pricing is not available online so it is advised to book a demo. One Honest Drawback: A large number of configuration options and capabilities mean there is a steep initial learning curve for employees to use this system. Although MeridianLink is a very powerful system, it may be difficult to implement due to how extensively it can be configured and requires a prolonged time to implement.

sections.title: 7. Blue Sage
sections.content: Blue Sage provides a complete suite of digital lending platforms for the mortgage industry. They focus on the use of artificial intelligence technology to create faster and more efficient processing of loans while maintaining compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. Its vision is to create a holistic, consistent, scalable and seamless digital mortgage experience by utilizing all aspects of AI in their entire lending process to help lower costs and increase efficiency. Best for: Institutions searching for a modern, cloud-native Loan Origination System (LOS) that they can have up and running in 6 to 10 months. These institutions operate through retail, wholesale and correspondent channels and are looking for a single unified system of record. Core Strengths: The mortgage business software is built from scratch to be 100% browser-based. Therefore, it offers a fast, scalable, and accessible application to any user with a web-enabled device. It is a single platform merging LOS, POS and digital servicing. It removes the requirement for third-party software. With in-depth AI integration, it offers smart task automation, quick document identification and 24/7 sales agent for looking after leads. Lenders can customize Blue Sage according to their platforms as it offers high-configuration flexibility. Key Features: Blue Sage offers a mobile-optimized borrower portal that works on quick document uploading, real-time tracking and faster eSigning. Workflow/tasks will be executed automatically based on trigger events, Has an AI-based conversational agent used by loan officers to create loan scenarios, look up required loan data, and communicate with borrowers. Compliance with federal, state, and local regulations is built-in, with real-time verification and regulatory analysis completed at every phase in the loan process. Pricing: Blue Sage does not offer prices available to the public at this time. So, booking a demo is the right way to discover its features. Each quote is provided solely for that quote’s circumstances. The solution is generally delivered using Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) pricing model. One Honest Drawback: Many end-users report that the platform operates at high levels of performance. However, many end-users have also stated that implementation costs are significantly higher along with the ongoing costs of consulting and customizations.

sections.title: 8. LendingPad
sections.content: LendingPad is a technologically advanced, cloud-created loan origination (LOS) software created for mortgage agency lenders and small to medium teams in search of budget-friendly software that is efficient and In compliance with laws. Its strengths consist of built-in collaborative features, real-time updates via MISMO data, and built-in AUS integration. While its fees tend to be lower than traditional platforms’, some users reported mid-level third party integration. Best For: It is an affordable cloud-based loan origination software solution for independent brokers and/or small-to-medium teams that want an accessible, highly responsive, full-featured platform. As cloud-based software, remote employees working from any secure web browser have secure access to the application and corresponding database. Key Strengths: Affordably priced with a great focus on efficiency rather than needing more amounts of time and effort to maintain. Include automated compliance review tools, CRM and document management capabilities, and automated underwriting systems. Allows many users to edit the same document at the same time which increases the amount of work that can be completed accurately and quickly. Simple/quick and easy setup does not require extensive IT support. Key Features: Custom versions of software are available for brokers, lenders, banks and credit unions. Bi-directional API interfaces for real-time data sharing; built-in lender marketplace AWS-based hosting and annual SSAE16 SOC2 audit for maximum security It has automated workflow tools Pricing: Approximately $40–$55 per user/month. Per-user subscription (monthly or annually). Trial/Demo is available for loan officers (to obtain full details) One Honest Drawback: Users may experience fewer third party integrations with smaller, less traditional, niche type products versus legacy, large product offerings.

sections.title: 9. TurnKey Lender
sections.content: TurnKey Lender is an established leader in AI-enabled application processing automation in an end-to-end automated process. It uses advanced deep learning neural networks, and machine language algorithms to predictively score each applicant’s creditworthiness in less than 30 seconds. The key functions of this software solution include origination, underwriting, servicing, collection of debts, and compliance. Best for: Alternative lenders Fintech start-ups Embedded finance providers Traditional financial institutions looking to transform digitally and rapidly at scale Businesses wanting to get new lending products to market quickly ie BNPL/Buy Now Pay Later, Personal Loans etc. Core Strength: Through the use of proprietary artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, TurnKey can automate the whole loan lifecycle in one place very quickly. It results in risk and cost reductions and fosters smart decision making. Key Features: Use of deep neural networks to analyze the borrower’s risk based on both traditional and alternative data. Removes paper applications by digitizing the whole application process allowing for custom workflows, web-flow, and automated KYC/AML checks. Allows users to configure credit product parameters without having to write any code. Manages repayment schedules, sends reminders, collects automatically, and, increases cash flow. White label borrower portal provides an interface that lets borrowers apply for loans and manage their repayments easily. Pricing: Turnkey Lender has pricing (and subscription pricing typically starts at approximately $500 per month). The ultimate price is customized depending on the actual type of lending entity, size of the organization, and functionality of features needed. You can get a custom quote for your lender operation. One Honest Drawback: The lending solution platform TurnKey Lender provides complete lending services but its main service area covers consumer and alternative lending markets which include personal loans and BNPL services. The mortgage brokers will discover that certain platform functions do not match their standard home loan processes because the software lacks complete mortgage LOS capabilities.

sections.title: 10. Finflux
sections.content: Finflux is an end-to-end “cloud-based” lending solution for digital lenders, microfinance companies, and the fintech industry. FinFlux combines loan origination, loan administration, and collection processes into one software solution. By having an extensible design and API integrations, Finflux automates workflow processes and increases operational efficiency by overseeing the complete loan process. Best for: Online lending companies, microfinance organizations, fintech startups that need a detailed, cloud-based full-loan lifecycle management solution. Core strength: Finflux provides complete end-to-end cloud-based solutions for each step in the lending process. It provides maximum flexibility and integration capabilities for users who typically do not have in-house developers. It works well with other mortgage systems. Each service works together seamlessly to provide lower costs and higher quality results than if the services were purchased separately. Key features: Automates all the activities associated with the origination of loans. This includes the onboarding of borrowers through KYC verification, credit assessments and subsequent approvals. Tracks all aspects of loans during their life cycle including disbursement, payment, interest calculation, servicing and so on. Allows users to create collections strategies by using different types of automated reminders (letters, emails, SMS) to remind customers of past due payments, as well as manage recovery processes. Give users the flexibility to connect to external systems such as Credit Bureaus, Payment Gateways, and Analytics Platforms. Pricing: Generally comes with a monthly/annual fee as per customer needs. Pricing will vary based on business growth potential, as well as the size of the lender, loan volume for each client and features required by each lender.
